items.summary: Agreed. Codex is far ahead of the other labs with their remote stuff. That said - I'd argue T3 Code is even further. Project creation, multi-pc management, remote configuration, and also open source :) Federico Viticci (@viticci) It's honestly remarkable how good *and* unique Codex Remote for iOS is. Other companies' "remote control" features force you to start from a Mac (Claude, Cursor). Codex Remote is, as far as I know, the only one with full start-from-iOS flow, near desktop parity, and a voice mode. I coordinate dozens of threads from iOS on a daily basis. The voice mode is especially impressive since it can dispatch to individual threads, load all your context + plugin/skills from desktop, and even reopen threads on-screen. I recently set up a second Mac mini (a Tahoe machine for backwards compatibility of my CLIs) and Codex Remote voice mode guided me through the process of setting up a Comet Remote KVM while I was wearing AirPods.
